Biggest ask first

A retreat is a lot to say yes to

Your bio link opens the retreat page. Someone who found you through a reel yesterday is asked for the biggest commitment first, and most quietly scroll on.

Hidden courses

Your courses wait to be found

They're in your bio, but nobody is shown them at the moment they've just said yes to something. That's when a first purchase is easiest.

Reach

New leads follow the algorithm

4 of your last 7 reels went past 2k views. When a reel travels, people find you; when it doesn't, the week is quiet, and there's no system turning attention into sign-ups.

The women not ready for a retreat or 1:1 today leave without a next step built for them, and you can't tell who is ready.

My recommendation

A free masterclass between your reels and your retreat

You already have courses, so the class can be free. Your course becomes the thank-you page offer, and the replay page is where the right women apply for 1:1 coaching or the retreat.

Fixes the missing entry offer

A free seat is a yes anyone who watches your reels can say today. Every sign-up is an email you keep, whether she buys or not.

Gives your courses a front door

The thank-you page offers your course the moment she's said yes, so the 95% have something to buy and a first win with your work.

Women who watch to the end and apply have raised their hand. The application filters them before your calendar, and course revenue helps pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 or a retreat yet

They join the free class, many buy your course on the thank-you page, and they stay on your list. You get paid to start the relationship instead of losing her to the scroll.

The qualified 5%

Ready to go deeper with you

They stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application shows you who they are, and the pre-call emails warm them up for 1:1 coaching or the Arise Immersive Retreat.

Before you save your seat

Is it really free?

Yes. The class, the live Q&A and the worksheet are free.

Register anyway. The replay is available for 72 hours after the class.

Script 1 · "The familiar"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Why do so many women end up in a new version of the same relationship?"

Body

"It's rarely bad luck. What feels like chemistry is often just what feels familiar. Once a woman can see her pattern, she can start choosing differently, and that's a skill anyone can learn."

CTA

"I'm teaching it in a free 60-minute live masterclass. The replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat."

Shot: talking to camera, light room, white outfit, green plant in frame.

Script 2 · "Name it"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's one emotional intelligence skill most of us were never taught."

Body

"Naming what we feel. Not 'fine', not 'stressed'. The real word. Once we can name a feeling, we can work with it instead of being run by it. It's the first step of the method I teach: feel, understand, choose."

CTA

"I'll walk through all three steps in my free masterclass. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text "feel · understand · choose" in sage.

Script 3 · "The first boundary"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"The first boundary is always the hardest. Here's why."

Body

"For many women, a boundary feels like a risk: of conflict, of being too much, of being left. So they soften it until it disappears. A boundary that holds is calm, clear and short, and it gets easier every time."

CTA

"I'll show you what that sounds like in my free live class. Seats are free. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to three short boundary phrases on screen.
